# backend-skeleton

> Reference for organizing backend code (TypeScript/Node.js) by **app cases**, also called vertical slicing, with optional Clean Architecture and DDD. One folder per user intent (endpoint, handler, command) holds its controller, app rules, tests and slice card. It includes a runnable dependency-free example, a zero-dependency import-boundary checker, and portable AGENTS.md and Agent Skill files for coding agents.

Key rules: an app case never imports another app case; domain/ is pure; modules are imported only through their index.ts; cross-module needs are injected as functions; the composition root (main/) wires everything.

## Tools for your project
- [AGENTS.md template](https://github.com/m-arrieta-r/backend-skeleton/blob/main/templates/AGENTS.md)
- [create-app-case Agent Skill](https://github.com/m-arrieta-r/backend-skeleton/blob/main/skills/create-app-case/SKILL.md): in Claude Code, `/plugin marketplace add m-arrieta-r/backend-skeleton` then `/plugin install app-cases@backend-skeleton`
- [check-boundaries.mjs](https://github.com/m-arrieta-r/backend-skeleton/blob/main/scripts/check-boundaries.mjs)
